meta.title: Remote DSH (OpenSSH)
meta.description: Embeds the full remote DSH web GUI in Desktop over a direct OpenSSH connection. Hosts come from ~/.ssh/config and reuse your keys, ssh-agent and known_hosts; an unknown host key fails closed. A healthy remote dsh web is attached as-is, otherwise a matching runtime is side-installed in its own directory — remote processes are never killed or restarted silently, unsafe takeovers ask for manual action. The gateway heals its own auth token, and a dropped session asks you to reconnect manually. This first release supports DSH 0.2.2-rc.3 on Linux remotes only.
